name: tool-dev-lifeops
description: Turns a messy real-world situation into a structured, prioritised action plan using the host LLM.
author: LifeOps
_comment: `tool_id` here is the LOCAL DEV discovery id only — it is how `anna-app dev` spawns and routes to this stdio process. It is never published. At `anna-app apps publish` the platform mints the real catalogue tool_id and injects it into the bundle via the generated bundle/anna-tool-ids.js. `type` selects the local spawn strategy (uv run) and is independent of `distribution.active`, which selects the publish profile.
